name: Characteristic Equation Roots Disguise
description: Replaces the geometric series convergence requirement with a requirement that the characteristic equation of a specified linear recurrence has distinct roots. The recurrence is chosen such that its roots are exactly the two harmonic multipliers, meaning distinct roots perfectly enforce the inequality constraint without explicitly stating it. This obscures the simple graph coloring structure, preventing models from relying on rote graph coloring algorithms and forcing them to either simplify the math or solve a generic CSP.
